subject.title: fix(memory-lancedb): prefer newer memories for latest queries

question: Should memory-lancedb solve freshness-sensitive questions with a narrow createdAt rerank plus provenance hint now, or wait for structured source metadata/live history routing before accepting this behavior?
rationale: The linked bug is real, but the PR chooses one product boundary among recency ranking, source metadata, provenance wording, and live/history lookup without maintainer-confirmed direction.

options.title: Land a narrow recency/provenance repair
options.body: Port a minimal createdAt rerank and freshness caveat to the current before_prompt_build path, with tests and real behavior proof, while tracking richer source metadata separately.

options.title: Require structured provenance first
options.body: Pause this PR until memory entries carry source timestamps and channel/thread provenance so latest/current answers do not rely on ingest time alone.

options.title: Close this stale branch and keep the issue
options.body: Use the canonical issue for the product decision and ask for a fresh PR against current main instead of repairing this conflicting branch.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow recency/provenance repair
recommendation.body: Port a minimal createdAt rerank and freshness caveat to the current before_prompt_build path, with tests and real behavior proof, while tracking richer source metadata separately.
